authorization: User requested a less stringent, coursework-appropriate acceptance rubric and clearer presentation of positive effects.
timingDisclosure: Added after the 80-step diagnostic runs and after the 160-step main execution began. These additional endpoints are descriptive, not preregistered confirmatory tests.
engineeringAcceptance: Implemented features, regression checks and verified recall improvements, reported separately from coding-task results.
targetRepairSuccess: Every declared FAIL_TO_PASS test passes after the submitted patch. Regression preservation is reported separately; this does not mean complete task success.
targetRepairFraction: Fraction of declared FAIL_TO_PASS tests passed after the submitted patch, averaged equally across tasks. Empty or inapplicable patches earn zero target-repair credit.
anyTargetRepair: At least one declared FAIL_TO_PASS test passes, including fully repaired target-test sets.
partialTargetRepair: At least one but not all declared FAIL_TO_PASS tests pass.
completeSuccess: Original endpoint: every declared FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS test passes with a validated failing baseline.
presentation: Report all tiers for both arms with explicit denominators. Preserve incomplete submissions, regressions, negative findings and uncertainty. No case replacement, selective reruns or outcome-based threshold tuning.
